rule.statement: A spouse fails to succeed to a holding if they do not enter into possession within six months of the permit-holder's death.
rule.supporting_quote: if a spouse of a permit-holder does not enter into possession of the land or holding in question within a period of six months reckoned from the date of the death of the permit-holder the said spouse would fail to succeed to the land so held by the permit-holder on the permit.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 68 (1) of the Land Development (Amendment) Act
